entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No. 3/2023 dated 03.01.2023 under Section 420/34 IPC registered at P.S.: New Friends Colony, primarily on the ground that this matter originally is in the realm of a civil dispute between the parties and civil suits have also been filed, which are pending.
Issue notice.
Mr. Kunal Mittal, learned counsel for Additional Standing Counsel accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
Issue notice to Respondent No.2, through all permissible modes, returnable on 13.03.2024.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
